title: 第20章 半重剑意雏形
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
“筑基期！他是筑基老怪！”

    身后护法的面容枯槁中年人和独眼老者吓得魂飞魄散。

    他们怎么也想不到，自己盯了三天的炼气期肥羊，竟然是一个扮猪吃虎的筑基期修士。

    真是常年打雁，如今被雁啄了眼。

    两人没有任何犹豫，甚至连同伴的尸体都顾不上看一眼，各自一拍储物袋，祭出防御法器，拼了命地朝密室外逃去。

    “既然来了，就留下吧。”

    林渊声音冷漠。

    既然动了手，就绝不能留下任何活口。

    他右手屈指一弹。

    咻咻咻咻！

    四枚寸许长、通体由液化灵力凝聚而成的金色长针暴射而出。

    一阶攻击法术，金针术。

    在炼气期时，金针术需要掐诀念咒，威力有限。

    但如今林渊晋升筑基，体内灵力液化，神识强大，一阶法术已能做到瞬发。

    四枚金针在空中划过诡异的弧线，带着刺耳的破空声，分别打向两人的后心与法器死角。

    两名劫修大骇，不得不停下身形，御使法器抵挡金针。

    当当两声，金针虽然被他们的防护法器挡下，但其中蕴含的筑基期巨力，却将两人的身形生生震退了三步，护体灵光一阵剧烈摇晃。

    就在这耽搁的半个呼吸间，林渊的御剑术已然发动。

    悬浮在半空中的金螭剑化作一道金色残影，在空中划过一个完美的半圆，如流星赶月般从两人的颈部一绕而过。

    噗通，噗通。

    两颗头颅冲天而起，鲜血如泉涌般喷洒在密室的石壁上。

    两具无头尸体晃了晃，软倒在地。

    从血刀老五破门而入，到三名劫修彻底横尸当场，整个过程甚至不到十个呼吸。

    战局在极短的时间内结束，动静极小，甚至没有惊动客栈上方的其他散修。

    林渊面无表情地收回金螭剑，剑身上滴血不沾，依旧暗金内敛。
content_en:
"Foundation Establishment Stage! He is the old Monster of Foundation Establishment!"

    The guardians behind him, the middle-aged man with a withered face and the one-eyed old man, were frightened to death.

    They never imagined that the fat sheep in the Qi Refining Stage that they had been staring at for three days turned out to be a Foundation Establishment Stage monk who pretended to be a pig and eat the tiger.

    I have been hunting geese all year round, but now my eyes were pecked by geese.

    Without any hesitation, the two of them didn't even bother to glance at their companion's body. They each patted their storage bags, took out their defensive weapons, and fled toward the secret room with all their might.

    "Now that you're here, stay."

    Lin Yuan's voice was cold.

    Now that we have taken action, we must not leave anyone alive.

    He flicked his right hand.

    Whoosh! Whoosh!

    Four inches long golden needles, whose entire body was condensed from liquefied spiritual power, shot out.

    First-level attack spell, golden needle technique.

    During the Qi refining period, the Golden Needle technique requires pinching and chanting incantations, so its power is limited.

    But now that Lin Yuan has been promoted to Foundation Establishment, the spiritual power in his body has been liquefied, his spiritual consciousness is powerful, and first-level spells can be cast instantly.

    The four golden needles drew strange arcs in the air, with a harsh sound of breaking through the air, and hit the back of the two people and the blind spots of the magic weapon respectively.

    The two tribulation cultivators were so horrified that they had to stop and use their magic weapons to resist the golden needles.

    With two clanging sounds, although the golden needles were blocked by their protective magic weapons, the huge power of the foundation-building stage contained in them shook the two of them back three steps, and the protective aura shook violently.

    In this delayed half-breath, Lin Yuan's sword control skills had already been activated.

    The Golden Chi Sword suspended in mid-air turned into a golden afterimage, drawing a perfect semicircle in the air, passing by the necks of the two men like a meteor chasing the moon.

    Plop, plop.

    Two heads soared into the sky, and blood sprayed like a fountain on the stone wall of the secret room.

    The two headless corpses shook and fell limply to the ground.

    From the time Blood Knife Lao Wu broke in through the door to the time when the three robbery cultivators were completely dead on the spot, the whole process took less than ten breaths.

    The battle ended in a very short period of time, with very little movement, not even disturbing the other casual cultivators above the inn.

    Lin Yuan took back the Golden Chi Sword with an expressionless face. There was no blood on the sword, and the dark gold was still restrained.
